main_body: Round leafy canopy made of overlapping lobes, on a brown trunk with a flared root base
top_band: Mid and light greens on the top of the canopy lobes, rows ~1-10, brightest at the upper-left of each lobe. Below that the canopy turns darker green, then the brown trunk
evidence: The canopy is a domed volume. Lit tops of the lobes are several rows tall, and darker green clumps sit beneath them, with a deep shadow where the canopy meets the trunk. The trunk is a vertical face with a wide flared base, not a flat elevation. For an organic plant this reads as a correct 3/4 mass, with no receding side faces.

style.evidence: The canopy has 5-6 greens, with per-clump highlights, dark gaps between lobes and dithered speckle. The trunk has 4-5 browns with vertical bark grain and a root flare. Outlines are dark green next to leaves and dark brown next to wood, not neutral black. No large flat areas. It is as rich as the references.
